exact_intake_statement: Prove that critical bond percolation on Z^2 at p = 1/2 is conformally invariant in the scaling limit (Cardy's formula and convergence of interfaces to SLE(6)), as is known on the triangular lattice by Smirnov.

working_formulation.model: Independent Bernoulli(1/2) nearest-neighbour bonds on canonical square-lattice approximations of a bounded Jordan domain, with no extra boundary identifications for the crossing formulation.
working_formulation.crossings: For four distinct counterclockwise boundary marks a,b,c,d and a conformal map to H sending them to 0,eta,1,infinity with 0<eta<1, the conjectured limit of the open ab-to-cd crossing probability is C(eta), the normalized integral from 0 to eta of [s(1-s)]^(-2/3).
working_formulation.interfaces: For two distinct boundary marks and explicitly induced primal/dual Dobrushin boundary conditions, conjectured convergence of the medial exploration interface to chordal SLE(6), in a specified curve topology. The independent reduction proves neither the observable limits nor the trace-convergence premise.

bounded_primary_literature_check.finding: Smirnov's established conformal-invariance result concerns critical triangular-lattice site percolation; it is not a square-bond theorem.

Abstract claims square-bond SLE(6) convergence, but the authors' comments call this a preliminary version and report critical comments and a planned clean proof. v4 is listed as withdrawn. No soundness judgment of v5 is made here.

A 115-page Wang Zhou preprint claims square-bond SLE(6) convergence via decomposition of the parafermionic observable. The bounded search recovered the claim, not independent verification or a journal acceptance. Full HTML fetch of v1 exceeded the web tool's size limit; the paper has not been mathematically audited here.

Duminil-Copin et al. prove large-scale rotational invariance for square-lattice random-cluster q in [1,4], including Bernoulli percolation. Their introduction presents this as a step towards full conformal invariance; it does not identify square-bond interfaces as SLE(6).
